item.title: Kazakhstan Becomes World’s Second-Largest Gold Buyer in 2025 Amid Record Prices
item.description: The Astana Times provides news and information from Kazakhstan and around the world. ASTANA – Kazakhstan purchased 57 tons of gold in 2025, making it the second-largest buyer worldwide, behind Poland, which purchased 102 tons. Rising metal prices and geopolitical uncertainty drove demand for safe-haven assets. Azerbaijan (53.4 tons), Brazil (42.8 tons), and Türkiye (26.1 tons) rounded out the top five buyers.
